articles.theme: A matte ivory articulated humanoid performing a high side kick on a small circular stage; a suspended translucent strip of three sequential motion frames becomes a delicate coral skeletal rig, with fine visible finger joints. Show the transition from imagined motion to an editable animated character, not a robot assistant. Accent electric coral and muted teal.

An artist's orderly worktable with three upright portrait boards of the same invented clothed mannequin: one richly textured color and fabric reference, one simple clean white clay pose maquette, and one finished harmonious figure assembled from both. Tiny drifting pigment fragments resolve into a clean composition. Make structure and visual identity visibly separate; no literal human faces. Accent cobalt blue and warm terracotta.

Two elegant wooden articulated animation mannequins of different heights rehearsing a choreographed martial arts exchange, each standing on clearly marked planted feet. Behind them a curved filmstrip and a sparse joint graph connect to a miniature editable animation timeline. Make the two character tracks and foot contact visually legible. Accent vermilion and petrol blue.

A very small ceramic sound module on an oversized oak desk beside a studio microphone, emitting layered sculptural sound ribbons and softly illuminated waveform arches. A second still smaller module suggests two compact speech engines, without numbers or labels. Convey expressive speech from modest local hardware. Accent amber and deep blue.

A cinematic film frame opens into a miniature playable floating-island adventure: a tiny caped courier, ivory stone paths, a coral paper kite and a sculptural game controller. A short strip of storyboard frames flows into the game world. Communicate moving from a gameplay idea in a video to an interactive browser game. Accent sky blue and burnt orange.

A beautifully proportioned small science-fiction habitat in white architectural model material, roof and walls gently exploded into ordered components above an architect's drafting sheet. Surround it with eight small clean orthographic silhouette tiles of the same building, with thin dimension lines but no numerals. Communicate references, proportions and geometry before materials. Accent safety orange and graphite.

A restrained editorial still-life about fictional character consistency: two porcelain theatrical masks and a neutral articulated fashion mannequin on separate movable identity and pose boards. Gentle colored guide rays keep the mannequin's pose and studio illumination fixed while the decorative mask changes. Entirely invented stylized nonhuman identities, no real person's likeness, no deceptive before-after photographs. Accent lilac and ochre.

A friendly invented illustrated fox explorer on a standing transparent panel transforms into a layered 2D puppet: a few separated facial-expression layers, delicate triangular mesh lines and small pivot controls. A ceramic microphone and tiny camera sit beside it. The character remains flat illustrated art with spatially separated paper layers. Accent mint green and coral.

Six luminous stepped ivory blocks form a compact cinematic path through a short floating filmstrip; a finely crafted coral accelerator adapter plugs into a dark video workstation beneath them. Several separate sculptural sound ribbons fan out behind a translucent premium glass partition, subtly distinguishing core generation from optional studio features. Convey faster video sampling and practical resource boundaries, no stopwatch claims. Accent crimson and ice blue.

A tactile editor's desk: an elegant graphite pencil and coral eraser remove tangled ornamental ribbons from a cream manuscript, leaving a few clear purposeful ink strokes and small concrete-object sketches. A small reading lamp illuminates the revision. Convey thoughtful editing and factual clarity, not evasion or detection. No legible text or invented glyphs. Accent indigo and rust red.

An ivory paper storyboard with three sequential hand-drawn scenes of a little paper boat sailing past a tree and a lighthouse. A graphite drawing pencil becomes a graceful animated drawing hand; tiny coral, gold and blue paint fills appear progressively across the scenes. An understated timeline of colored blocks runs below, linking narration to drawing order. Accent warm ochre and cobalt.
